designs.why: Reads from 3 m: flame, rice and prawns make a strong silhouette, the halftone looks like a real print, and the black shirt does the shadow work. On the model it sits a bit low and small in the standard area, and the hand and handle end a little abruptly at the right instead of fading.
designs.fix: Soften the right edge of the hand and handle into a longer, more even fade, and scale the whole art up about 10 percent so it sits higher on the back.
